data.one_liner: A toolbar that aligns to the bottom of a widget and expands into a bottom sheet.
data.what_it_does: Provides a BottomSheetBar widget that sits at the bottom of a screen or widget as a collapsible toolbar and expands into a full bottom sheet. Supports a body widget underneath, custom content through an expandedBuilder, and a controller to manage its state programmatically.
use_when: You want a persistent bottom toolbar that expands into a full bottom sheet.
You need scrollable or complex content to reveal from the bottom of the screen upon user interaction.
avoid_when: You only need a standard Material bottom navigation bar or standard modal bottom sheet.
You do not need a toolbar-to-sheet expanding mechanism.
strengths: Smooth transition between collapsed toolbar and expanded bottom sheet.
Includes a controller to listen to events and programmatically expand or collapse.
Supports customizable border radiuses, shadows, backdrop colors, and safe area wrapping.
